home.heroSubtitle: Photography, video, design, digital marketing and training on the latest AI tools. A boutique team with ten years of work alongside brands.
home.introBody: TROIE is the agency of Hugues Lourmieres. Since 2015, we have worked with luxury houses, industrials and service companies in France and worldwide. We craft their imagery, advise their strategy, and train their teams on today's digital tools.
home.creationBody: We craft the visual content that gives shape to your brand. Photography, video, graphic identity, and generative creation.
creationItems: Video, brand films, reels, motion design
Visual identity, logo, complete graphic charter
Websites, web apps and landing pages
home.strategyBody: We support your brand, market and acquisition decisions: from brand platform to media plan, from SEO to paid.
strategyItems: Paid media: Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok
home.trainingBody: We train your teams on AI tools and on building autonomous agents. Three levels, in-house or open enrollment, in France or remote.
trainingItems: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini: advanced use and prompting
AI visual creation: Midjourney, Sora, Veo, Runway
home.worksIntro: Luxury houses, hospitality, sport, industry, technology. Project details available on request.
home.videosIntro: Client testimonials, brand films and storytelling. A selection of video productions for Rutherford, GS Monaco × Forbes, Autajon, Avery Dennison and others.
home.aboutBody: Chief Marketing Officer in the industrial and graphic arts sector, I lead brand strategy and content production for demanding players. Photographer, videographer and art director, I have worked with brands for ten years in France and internationally. I also train teams to embed AI into their daily production. TROIE brings these two worlds together, creative that gets seen and AI that ships, for demanding brands.
aboutBullets: Studio based in France, missions worldwide
home.packsIntro: Fixed-price packages for recurring needs. Custom quotes for everything else, after a free 30-minute audit.
home.packsTerms: All prices excluding VAT. Standard terms: 50 % on order, balance on delivery. Detailed quote within 48 hours of briefing.
